# New-ZbxServiceStatusRule

## SYNOPSIS

Builds a service status rule for the -StatusRule of New-ZbxService and Set-ZbxService.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxServiceStatusRule [-Type] <ZabbixServiceStatusRuleType> -LimitValue <int> -LimitStatus <ZabbixServiceStatus> -NewStatus <ZabbixSeverity> [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A status rule raises a service's status when enough of its child services are in a given state. The New-ZbxServiceStatusRule cmdlet writes it as a hashtable keyed by the API's field names, which the -StatusRule of New-ZbxService and Set-ZbxService take as it is, alone or in an array. -Type is positional. Nothing is sent to the server, so the command needs no connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a status rule and use it in a new service

```powershell
$rule = New-ZbxServiceStatusRule -Type AtLeastNWithStatusOrAbove -LimitValue 1 -LimitStatus High -NewStatus Disaster
New-ZbxService -Name 'Web checkout' -Algorithm MostCritical -Position 0 -Child 'Checkout' -StatusRule $rule |
    Select-Object Name, Algorithm
```

The builder writes one status-rule hashtable; New-ZbxService sends it in -StatusRule. This one reads: if at least 1 child is High or worse, set the service to Disaster.

### Example 2: Combine rules by count and by percentage

```powershell
$rules = @(
    New-ZbxServiceStatusRule -Type AtLeastPercentWithStatusOrAbove -LimitValue 50 -LimitStatus Average -NewStatus High
    New-ZbxServiceStatusRule -Type AtLeastNWithStatusOrAbove -LimitValue 2 -LimitStatus Disaster -NewStatus Disaster
)
$null = Set-ZbxService -InputObject 'Web checkout' -StatusRule $rules
(Get-ZbxService -Name 'Web checkout' -SelectStatusRules).StatusRules | Format-Table Type, LimitValue, LimitStatus, NewStatus
```

The Percent types compare -LimitValue as a percentage of the children; each rule sets -NewStatus when it matches, and the highest resulting status wins. -SelectStatusRules reads the rules back.

## PARAMETERS

### -Type

The condition that the rule tests: 0 at least N child services, 1 at least N percent of child services, 2 fewer than N child services, 3 fewer than N percent of child services, have the limit status or above for 0 and 1 and the limit status or below for 2 and 3; 4 to 7 test the same against the total weight of child services instead of their count.

| Type | `ZabbixServiceStatusRuleType` |
| Parameter sets | (All) |
| Aliases | none |
| Required | True |
| Position | 0 |
| Default value | None |
| Pipeline input | False |
| Wildcards | False |
